title: 🔥 Build a Tic-Tac-Toe Game with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! 🎮
description:
I just built a fully functional Tic-Tac-Toe game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! 🏆 This project includes a clean UI, smooth interactions, and a simple yet fun gameplay experience. You can play against a friend and reset the board anytime! 🎲💡

If you're learning JavaScript, this is a great project to practice DOM manipulation and game logic. 🚀 Check it out and let me know what you think! 💬
